==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Improve|March 2020}}
{{Compendium/Extract|Silver Bokoblin}}
Silver Bokoblins are much more clever, powerful, and dangerous than the other three lower-tiered [[Bokoblin]]s. Silver Bokoblins tend to use similar [[Weapon]]s to the [[Black Bokoblin]]s, including the [[Dragonbone Boko Club]]s, [[Dragon Bone Boko Bow|Bows]], and [[Dragonbone Boko Shield|Shields]].

The Silver Bokoblin retains all the skills other Bokoblins have, like kicking and avoiding [[Remote Bomb]]s. New to this Bokoblin is the faster reaction time and use of more powerful attack patterns. When first encountered, they tend to use a double slash attack and sometimes a slower single slash attack as well. They also use their jump and swinging attacks more often, lasting much longer than the weaker Bokoblins.

Silver Bokoblins are much stronger than all other Bokoblin variants due to being influenced by [[Ganon]]'s [[Darkness|Dark]] [[Magic]],<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> only being outclassed by the [[Golden Bokoblin]]s introduced during Master Mode. They carry stronger Weapons than other Bokoblins and may drop [[Bokoblin Horn]]s, [[Bokoblin Fang]]s, [[Bokoblin Guts]], [[Amber]], [[Opal]], [[Topaz]], [[Ruby|Rubies]], [[Sapphire]]s, and [[Diamond]]s when defeated.

==={{TotK|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Silver Bokoblin}}
Silver Bokoblins reappear in {{TotK}}, acting mostly the same as they did in {{BotW}}. However, they can now ram [[Link]] with their new [[Silver Bokoblin Horn]]s.

==Other Appearances==
==={{AoC|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Stub|AoC}}
Silver Bokoblins are the strongest type of [[Bokoblin]] in {{AoC}}. They have more health and do more damage, and they first appear in the [[Scenario]] "[[Calamity Strikes]]".

When defeated, they may drop [[Bokoblin Fang]]s, [[Bokoblin Horn]]s, and [[Bokoblin Guts]]. At the end of a [[Battle]], the [[Warrior]]s will be awarded with a [[Bokoblin Trophy]] for each slain Silver Bokoblin.
{{Noncanon|End}}
